comments.author: Donce
comments.body:
The solution could be more simple. In the old version of Uncharted Waters : New horizons, that I played some 10-15 years ago, deck battles worked this way:
You could only engage enemy flagship in a duel (deck battle) only if your crew number was equal or bigger than the opponents. Even if you had a little bit less crew you had a very small chance to engage duel.

Otherwise engaging in a duel resulted in a simple melee action.

In such way merchant ships with small crew didn't have a chance to defeat a big crew warship in a duel. They could only flee from the battle or die.

comments.body: So far I seem to see Deck Battle two ways... Takes forever to get into it vs npcs, but against real players in the game it automatically enters deck battle for them before the first melee round is even over. I generally run both land battle skills, have 100 dura body armor, and 100 dura boots. Deck battle against someone with god modded gear is just pointless. Until deck battle becomes an actual option, or god modded gear removed from the game, PVP in UWO will always be BS.
